Commentary.Commentary: That's a wrap, folks! The pre-tournament preparations are done and it is now time to gear up for the mega event. Both these teams will be looking to start their campaign with a win but for now, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

Let's now hear from Ishan Kishan - Kishan expresses his excitement about getting the opportunity to open the innings, but he also enjoyed batting at number 3. He emphasizes that he's focused on doing his best regardless of his batting position, especially with the World Cup approaching. He also attributes his success to being present in the moment, watching the ball closely, and playing the required shots. He credits the pitch for being tremendous to bat on in the second innings, saying he trusted the wicket's bounce. He also highlights the importance of Tilak Varma's comeback, noting that Varma brings more than just batting skills, as he can also contribute with the ball and provide stability in the middle order. He praises Varma's fielding and current batting form. Regarding bowling, Kishan acknowledges that there's always room for improvement. He feels that his team did well on the wicket, but the opposition bowled well too. He suggests that the team will review their bowling in the team meeting.

South Africa's efforts - The Proteas came into this clash on the back of a home series win against the Windies but their star batter, Quinton de Kock, didn't feature in this game. Skipper Aiden Markram played a solid knock up top but the likes of Dewald Brevis and David Miller disappointed. However, probably two batters that are vying for a spot in the Playing XI - Tristan Stubbs and Jason Smith played fighting knocks and Marco Jansen also managed to get a few big hits away.

India's story - After a scintillating display with the bat where plenty of batters got an eye in, the hosts did a fine job with the ball as well. Even without the services of Jasprit Bumrah, the Indian attack started positively as Arshdeep Singh got an early wicket. There was resistance all throughout from the Proteas but the likes of Singh and Varun Chakaravarthy bowled really well. Even the fringe bowlers like Shivam Dube and Abhishek Sharma were amongst the wickets. There is work to be done, though, as a few bowlers seemed out of touch and went for plenty of runs.

India almost at their peak - A fine all-round showing from the reigning T20 Champions and they have made a statement with this win. A win that will not just calm the nerves of a home tournament but will also send a signal to all the other teams. South Africa blew hot and cold all throughout the game but will be decently pleased as they got a high-octane game against a top side.

Commentary.Default_Commentary: 4.1: Harshit Rana to Ryan Rickelton, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Bowling change? Yes, indeed. Harshit Rana comes into the attack now.

FOUR! 9 runs off the over. South Africa need more from a single over. A slower bumper but serves with too much width. Aiden Markram rides the pull shot and hits it in the vacant deep mid-wicket region.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.6: Hardik Pandya to Aiden Markram, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller and on middle and leg, little bit of shape, Ryan Rickelton whips it behind square leg for a single.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.5: Hardik Pandya to Ryan Rickelton, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: In the 8-meter length, on top of middle, Aiden Markram works it down to mid off and runs across. Markram limps a bit as he jogs across.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.4: Hardik Pandya to Aiden Markram, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: Aiden Markram has taken a body blow here and is in a bit of pain. The physio is out to have a look and there's a bit of a pause in play right now. Markram is finally good to go again and play can resume.

Oh, Markram has taken a hit and is on his haunches with his face on the ground. Hardik Pandya follows Aiden Markram on the leg side with a hard length delivery. Markram fails to get his bat on it and wears it on the box. A bit painful and the physio is out.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.3: Hardik Pandya to Aiden Markram, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Three runs! Bowls it in line of the stumps, fuller length. Ryan Rickelton punches it to mid off where Abhishek Sharma dives over the ball and lets it through. Harshit Rana from mid on runs across and flicks it back near the fence. Saves a run.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.2: Hardik Pandya to Ryan Rickelton, 3 runs.

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on middle and leg, Ryan Rickelton punches it straight to mid on.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 3.1: Hardik Pandya to Ryan Rickelton, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Beaten! Singh ends the over well. Short of a good length, around the fourth stump. Aiden Markram tries to play it with a straight bat inside the line and misses.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.6: Arshdeep Singh to Aiden Markram, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Attacks the stumps with a length delivery. Ryan Rickelton punches with soft hands to mid off and scampers across. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Luckily, Ishan Kishan, the keeper covers a lot of ground to do the back up and stops it from running away.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.5: Arshdeep Singh to Ryan Rickelton, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Easy pickings! Ryan Rickelton is off the mark in style! Overpitched, slanting on the pads, this is flicked past mid-wicket and it rolls to the fence.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.4: Arshdeep Singh to Ryan Rickelton, Four!

Commentary.Commentary: Tap and run! A nagging length delivery, around off, Markram drops it in front of cover and calls for a quick single. SKY has a shy at the bowler's end but misses from a close range.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.3: Arshdeep Singh to Aiden Markram, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: A good length delivery, on top of off. Markram stays back and chops it to backward point.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.2: Arshdeep Singh to Aiden Markram, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Fourth six in the last four deliveries! Arshdeep Singh now bangs it short, not too short and lands nicely for Markram, who hoicks it across over mid-wicket for a six.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 2.1: Arshdeep Singh to Aiden Markram, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller delivery, around off, punched to mid off for a single to end the 19-run over.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.6: Hardik Pandya to Aiden Markram, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Hat trick of sixes! The crowd has gone pin drop silence already. Hardik Pandya bluffs with a shorter delivery, around off, Markram doesn't anticipate, stays back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a biggie.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.5: Hardik Pandya to Aiden Markram, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Even better from Markram! Hardik Pandya bowls in the slot, fuller delivery on middle, Markram lofts with a high elbow and hits it flat over long on for six more.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.4: Hardik Pandya to Aiden Markram, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! First boundary of the chase! Slightly short, around off, Markram trusts the carry off the deck and punches with a high backlift over long on for a six.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.3: Hardik Pandya to Aiden Markram, Six!

Commentary.Commentary: Beauty! Angles in a length ball, around the fourth stump and seams it away sharply. Markram gets on his toes as he gets forward. He tries to punch it away but misses.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.2: Hardik Pandya to Aiden Markram, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Bowls the hard length, wide of off, Markram hops and punches it to cover.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 1.1: Hardik Pandya to Aiden Markram, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: The move to send a pinch hitter to open the innings has backfired for South Africa. Ryan Rickelton walks in at number 3 and it will be Hardik Pandya to share the new ball with Arshdeep Singh.

OUT! TAKEN! Linde as an opener doesn't work! On a nagging length, swinging into the batter, on leg, George Linde plays a nothing shot, just tries to punch it away over mid on but mistimes and Hardik Pandya takes a dolly. A run and a wicket for India to begin it's defensive shift.
Commentary.Howout: c Hardik Pandya b Arshdeep Singh
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.6: Arshdeep Singh to George Linde, OUT! c Hardik Pandya b Arshdeep Singh.

Commentary.Commentary: BEATEN AGAIN! Fractionally fuller than the previous delivery, more shape on this one as Singh lands it on off, Linde swings wildly but connects the thin air around it.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.5: Arshdeep Singh to George Linde, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a good length, outside off, shaping away very late. George Linde slashes his blade without any foot movement and fails to connect.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.4: Arshdeep Singh to George Linde, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Oh, beautifully bowled! A well planted yorker into the blockhole, swings into the batter and George Linde manages to dig it out back onto the pads.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.3: Arshdeep Singh to George Linde, No run.

Commentary.Commentary: Outswinger this time, around off on a length. Aiden Markram taps it wide of point for a single. South Africa are underway in the chase.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.2: Arshdeep Singh to Aiden Markram, 1 run.

Commentary.Commentary: A good length delivery, swinging in sharply and on leg, Aiden Markram gets pinged on the pads as he looks to flick it away.
Commentary.Default_Commentary: 0.1: Arshdeep Singh to Aiden Markram, No run.
